title: NPC SecAct open-data analysis
description: Reproducibility package for a patient-level multimodal benchmark of treatment-associated inferred secreted-protein activity in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Version 1.1.0 adds the independently frozen 24-patient GSE299775 PanCK-positive metastasis extension, matched direct-expression benchmark, patient-level derived data, audit outputs, and vector figures. It does not establish measured protein secretion, a proven cellular source, treatment causality, SecAct superiority, incremental clinical value, or a validated clinical predictor.
